moa.t: Inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, blocking DNA synthesis in rapidly dividing trophoblast and other cells

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Methotrexate, IM, 50 mg/m2 of body surface area (BSA).
Methotrexate, oral, 7.5 mg once per week. Specialist consultation. · Increase dose gradually to a maximum of 25 mg per week. · Monitor: ALT and FBC before and 12 weekly during treatment.
Methotrexate, oral, 7.5 mg once weekly. · Dose titration should be based on individual patient response using increments of 2.5 mg weekly to a maximum dose of 25 mg weekly.

contraindications.t: Active peptic ulcer or pulmonary disease

cautions.t: Avoid folic acid, NSAIDs, cotrimoxazole and alcohol during ectopic treatment
Reliable contraception for at least 3 months afterwards

adverse_effects.t: Stomatitis, nausea, bone-marrow suppression, hepatotoxicity, pneumonitis

monitoring.t: FBC, renal and liver function before dosing, β-hCG follow-up
